capabilities.purpose: Resolve, reuse, open and close the fixed operating profile without duplicate windows.
Use the ws/http endpoint returned by BitBrowser with Playwright for live page operation and verification.
Enforce platform/site, ownership and fulfillment identity before actions.
Mirror non-sensitive operation IDs and outcomes while project JSONL remains authoritative.
Enter text into a focused real field when CDP fill is unreliable; verify persistence after save.
Run deterministic repetitive workflows with explicit stop rules.
Public competitor monitoring with one startup page; not the primary Seller Central session.
Expose current-page context, evidence and a safe command queue without exporting sessions or credentials.
Future mobile-channel workflows; asynchronous, billable and limited to one request per second.

extension_policy.installation_rule: Do not install or authorize until provenance, requested permissions, data destinations and platform-policy fit are reviewed.
